text: I answer the extension: it is a weight, not my test. sma_distance_pct 23.76 reads far from the 50-day on any leader at its high; C16 buys the instant a new high prints. The ma_200 12.47 climax line is oneil's. Mine: structure 74.5, day_vol 1.82, mp STRONG/ACCELERATING, W, D and H1 HH/HL with 9>21, D 0.1% under the last swing high. Hold ADVANCE. Clears me: a reaction of fade_atr_ge:2 off the day's high (my atr_14d translation), BEARISH_CHOCH, or no follow-through past the pivot (C17).
